modelIdentification.name: pyjevsim-relay
modelIdentification.description: Reference FOM for the 3-federate Generator → Buffer → Processor relay pipeline. Two interaction classes so the two pipeline edges are visually distinct in the event log.

interactionClass.name: GenToBuffer
interactionClass.semantics: Generator → Buffer edge of the relay pipeline.

parameter.name: seq
parameter.semantics: Monotonic sequence number stamped by the generator.

interactionClass.name: BufferToProc
interactionClass.semantics: Buffer → Processor edge of the relay pipeline. Carries the same seq the generator emitted; the buffer is a pass-through queue, not a transformer.

parameter.name: seq
parameter.semantics: The sequence number released from the head of the buffer queue.
